summary_en: 3,000,000 common shares to be cancelled (4.46% of shares outstanding). Effective date 26 August 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 64,244,284.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 21 July 2026, KPP Group Holdings' board of directors resolved to cancel 3,000,000 treasury common shares held by the company, pursuant to Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation is scheduled for 31 August 2026. The shares represent 4.46% of issued shares outstanding prior to cancellation. Post-cancellation, total issued shares (excluding treasury) will be 64,244,284.
